name: com.tencent.qcloud.tim.tuikit.live.modules.liveroom.ui.DefaultGroupLiveAnchorActivity
description: When a user starts a group live room in Tencent IM, this activity opens the host view, requests camera and microphone access, and sends room-status updates to the group.
disableEffect: Users may be unable to host Tencent IM group live rooms.
